reviewer_A_boundary_notes.rationale: Shared fiction-writing is broad; romcom plot outline, fable and named-character free story differ in central subject/genre/output demands.
Haiku adds a particular poetic form and required whale/tree subject, not only the matched four-line affect-poem variant.
A riddle elicits a puzzle; a humorous joke is a different central output. Ambiguous humorous riddles do not make all such prompts near duplicates.

Naming output form is common, but D&D character, filly and puffle have different entity/fiction domains. This deliberately narrow boundary needs reconciliation if pet naming is considered one task family; do not claim these singletons are proven independent.
Name an existing Indian-origin person asks for a real entity, unlike choosing a baby given name. Source category does not override that intent distinction.
Open gift idea versus choosing a specific handbag product. This narrower product-domain boundary is debatable; conservative reconciliation could expand the gift cluster.
Travel destination recommendation differs from describing a vacation benefit or naming a bad place to live.
Interesting unsolved problem versus personally difficult type of problem is not a mere paraphrase; the intended respondent/capability criterion differs. The ambiguity of personally is retained.

Acclaim query is matched; a specific book series and a dystopian bestseller domain are narrower factual selection tasks.81couldjoin under a looser acclaimed-book family, so this boundary is explicit for reconciliation.
Breed suitability advice is not simply naming an animal, despite shared animal vocabulary.

Listing people is broad; occupation/era/achievement-specific factual domains are not merged solely because outputs are human names. This narrower taxonomy should not be misrepresented as a semantic independence proof.
Random selection alone is broad. Playing cards, paired produce, postal codes, emoji, legal chess responses and animals involve distinct output domains/validation rules.

Four-digit lock code, four-character password, one first password digit and five-word hyphenated passphrase have different requested credential artifacts and literal lengths. A broader security-family merge is a reasonable conservative alternative, explicitly unresolved.

reviewer_D_uncertain_links.issue: Exact four-line poem template with love versus hatred. Opposed sentiment changes the communicative aim and admissible content; a broader emotional-poem template family would merge them. Reconcile before a split.
Same Pittsburgh fact template with cool versus uncool. The target fact valence differs; a template-level leakage policy could reasonably join them.
Both select a job, but reputation and dream desirability are different criteria. Same occupational domain alone is insufficient under the narrow rule.
Both ask for one boy given name, but Indian-son naming versus a popular Papua New Guinea name changes cultural/evidentiary constraints. Could be one localized baby-boy-naming template family.
Both identify a writer, but unrestricted popular writer versus renowned Nigerian writer substantially restricts the domain. Could be one writer-example family if locale constraints count as minor.
Online-store suggestions share wording, but dress versus wallet changes product domain and three versus one changes output cardinality. A broader retail-source template family could join them.

All choose short credentials, but lock digits and password characters differ in admissible alphabet and application. A shared four-character-secret family is plausible if these are minor format differences.
The first pair asks for highly regarded books; dystopian best-seller imposes both genre and sales criteria. Do not extend the pair merely because all return book titles.
Vacation destination versus three cities worth visiting overlaps in travel advice, but city-only domain and list cardinality differ; the latter is kept separate pending reconciliation.
The prime filter, d20 convention and range boundaries may be substantive rather than minor. This provisional merge is explicitly moderate-confidence, not an asserted semantic identity.
A dad joke is a genre-constrained instance of a funny joke. Keep this merge only if such subgenre restrictions fit the agreed narrow family rule.
Capital-city restriction is a subset of African-city examples. Reconcile whether that restriction is minor before assigning partitions.

split_recipe.primary_stratum: Most common original category in each accepted custody block; ties resolved by first source appearance of category.
split_recipe.seed_search: Integer seeds starting0; first seed with all known exposure closure in development and at least2distinct development blocks for every original category. No new model outputs used.
split_recipe.selection: Start [curated-0,curated-47,curated-97]. In original category first-appearance order, fill to2per originalcategory from development, sorted by SHA256(common._canonical([7,id])) then id; skip any globally already selected block.
split_recipe.split_function: buddha.splits.freeze_splits(Prompt(id,prompt), seed=common_seed, families=exact_block_map), called separately in each primary stratum; union the three named partitions.
